create_multiagent_gru: create a MultiAgentGRU module with shared or independent parameters for multiple agents
build_gru_model: build a Gru model with configurable hidden size, layers, dropout, and compile options
run_gru_forward: run the GRU forward pass with input tensors, is_init flags, and hidden states
configure_gru_config: configure a GruConfig dataclass with hidden size, layers, bias, dropout, and MLP settings
get_gru_net: get a compiled or uncompiled GRU network via get_net with specified input and hidden sizes
